payload.name: MediPrep Study Navigator
payload.description: 将课程映射为学习路径
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MediPrep Study Navigator helps medical students turn lectures and study topics into reviewed, source-safe learning routes. ChatGPT analyzes learner-provided files and sends MediPrep only short medical concept phrases; MediPrep returns coordinated video metadata, rights-approved shared UWorld question IDs when available, public references, and human-published MediPrep practice. MediPrep does not receive uploaded files or proprietary question bodies. Third-party product names are used descriptively; MediPrep is not affiliated with or endorsed by their owners.
payload.longDescription: MediPrep Study Navigator 帮助医学生将课程和学习主题转化为经过审查、来源合规的学习路径。ChatGPT 分析学习者提供的文件，仅向 MediPrep 发送简短的医学概念短语；MediPrep 返回配套的视频元数据、在可用时提供经权利许可共享的 UWorld 题目 ID、公开参考资料，以及由人工发布的 MediPrep 练习。MediPrep 不会接收上传的文件或专有题目的正文。第三方产品名称仅用于描述；MediPrep 与这些名称的所有者不存在关联，也未获其背书。

payload.name: Joe Speaking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Joe Speaking to ChatGPT to explore current IELTS Speaking questions, see which topics you have or have not practised, review your saved Recording Practice and Live Conversation history, discuss scores and feedback, and choose what to practise next.
payload.longDescription: 将 Joe Speaking 连接到 ChatGPT，探索最新的 IELTS 口语题目，查看哪些主题练习过或尚未练习，回顾已保存的录音练习和实时对话记录，讨论分数与反馈，并选择下一步练习内容。

payload.name: 受験王
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 受験王 helps users create custom multiple-choice study questions in ChatGPT and save them to a private question library for later review and practice.
payload.longDescription: 受験王 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中创建自定义选择题，并将其保存到私人题库，以便之后复习和练习。

payload.name: 교보문고
payload.description: 发现好书，找到心仪读物
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kyobo Book Centre is Korea's largest and most trusted bookstore. Search for the books you want and discover new reads—all without leaving the chat.
• Looking for a specific author? – "Which Han Kang book should I start with?"
• Browsing by topic? – "Show me popular books on investing"
• Need one for the moment? – "I just became a team lead—what should I read?"
• Picking a gift? – "A book for my history-loving dad"
No keyword guessing needed. Kyobo Book Centre finds your next read.
payload.longDescription:
Kyobo Book Centre 是韩国规模最大、最受信赖的书店。无需离开聊天，即可搜索想读的书并发现新书。
• 在找某位特定作者的书？——“我该从韩江的哪本书开始读？”
• 想按主题浏览？——“给我看看热门投资书籍。”
• 想找适合当下的书？——“我刚成为团队负责人，应该读什么？”
• 正在挑礼物？——“给我爱历史的爸爸挑一本书。”
无需猜关键词。Kyobo Book Centre 帮你找到下一本好书。

payload.name: 小テストジェネレーター
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PrintGenerator helps users search public vocabulary lists and their own UserBook lists from ChatGPT. It supports vocabulary details, flashcards, multiple-choice quizzes, and study using remembered or unremembered words. When needed, it can also create a share link to open a list in the Flutter app.
payload.longDescription: PrintGenerator 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索公开词汇表和自己的 UserBook 词表。它支持词汇详情、抽认卡、选择题测验，以及使用已记住或尚未记住的单词进行学习。必要时，还可以创建分享链接，在 Flutter 应用中打开词表。

payload.name: SAMRUM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your SAMRUM account to talk through your family's personality profiles, reports and focus tracks in ChatGPT.

SAMRUM is a family personality tool: each person takes their own test at samrum.io and gets a profile of 10 everyday tendencies, based on the Big Five and the Interpersonal Circumplex. SAMRUM then shows the patterns that arise between two people – partners, parent and child, or siblings.

In ChatGPT you can:
- ask what your own profile says, or compare two family members side by side (shown as a chart)
- go through a couple, parent-child, sibling or family report one pattern at a time
- see this week's step in a focus track
- revisit your latest Right now guides after an argument

ChatGPT only reads what you can already see in SAMRUM. It shows nicknames and coarse levels (high, middle, low) – never raw answers, exact scores or full names – and it can't change anything in your account. You need a SAMRUM account with at least one completed test.
payload.longDescription:
连接你的 SAMRUM 账户，在 ChatGPT 中讨论家人的性格档案、报告和重点培养计划。

SAMRUM 是一款家庭性格工具：每个人都在 samrum.io 完成自己的测试，并获得一份基于大五人格和人际环形模型的档案，其中包含 10 项日常倾向。SAMRUM 随后会展示两个人之间形成的模式，例如伴侣、家长与孩子或兄弟姐妹之间的互动。

在 ChatGPT 中，你可以：
- 询问自己的档案内容，或并排比较两位家庭成员（以图表显示）
- 一次查看一项伴侣、亲子、手足或家庭报告中的模式
- 查看本周重点培养计划中的步骤
- 争吵后重新查看最新的 Right now 指南

ChatGPT 只读取你在 SAMRUM 中本来就能看到的内容。它显示昵称和粗略等级（高、中、低），绝不会显示原始答案、精确分数或全名，也无法更改账户中的任何内容。你需要拥有 SAMRUM 账户，且至少完成一项测试。

payload.name: STILL Artwork Credits
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create source-aware artwork credits, figure captions, and citations in Chicago, MLA, and APA. Import supported artwork records from The Met and the Cleveland Museum of Art, or provide metadata manually. STILL preserves museum credit lines, source URLs, licensing information, provenance, warnings, and exact UTC observation times. Available in English and Ukrainian. Generated credits do not grant permission to use an image and are not legal clearance.
payload.longDescription: 生成注明来源的作品说明、图注，以及 Chicago、MLA 和 APA 格式的引文。可导入 The Met 和克利夫兰艺术博物馆支持的作品记录，也可手动提供元数据。STILL 会保留博物馆署名行、来源 URL、许可信息、出处记录、警告，以及精确到 UTC 的观察时间。支持英语和乌克兰语。生成的署名信息并不授予图片使用权限，也不构成法律许可。

payload.name: CLSTR
payload.description: 跟踪持续发展的新闻事件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CLSTR gives ChatGPT memory of the news. It reads over 100,000 articles a day from 40,000+ sources, groups every article about the same event into one deduplicated item, and links related events into "situations": ongoing storylines with a maintained summary and a full timeline.

Ask what is happening around a topic, company, country or event and get one synthesized storyline instead of twenty near-duplicate headlines. Ask what has happened with a situation since a given date and get the whole arc, in order, with a count of how many sources reported each development and a link to every one of them.

What it can do:
- Search the news by topic, entity, company or country
- List the situations developing right now, optionally by category, country or time window
- Return the complete timeline of one situation, newest first
- Return the detail of a single event with its source articles
payload.longDescription:
CLSTR 为 ChatGPT 提供新闻记忆。它每天从 40,000+ 个来源读取 100,000 多篇文章，将报道同一事件的文章归并为一个去重条目，并将相关事件关联到“情势”中：也就是持续发展的新闻故事线，包含持续更新的摘要和完整时间线。

询问某个主题、公司、国家或事件的最新情况，即可获得一条综合故事线，而非 20 条近似重复的标题。询问某个情势自指定日期以来发生了什么，即可按顺序获取完整进展、每项动态的报道来源数量，以及每个来源的链接。

可执行的操作：
- 按主题、实体、公司或国家搜索新闻
- 列出当前正在发展的情势，可按类别、国家或时间范围筛选
- 返回某个情势的完整时间线，按最新内容排在前
- 返回单个事件的详情及其来源文章

payload.name: Dike
payload.description: 搜索并引用中东和北非法律
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dike connects ChatGPT to primary legal sources from Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, and Egypt, in Arabic and English. Search legislation, court rulings, and fatawa. Get answers that cite the retrieved source text. Resolve a citation, such as a law number and year, to the document it refers to. Check whether a law has been amended or repealed by following its citation graph. Answers are checked against the retrieved sources before they are returned, and claims that cannot be verified are left out. Coverage varies by country. For example, UAE material is currently court decisions and rules from the DIFC and ADGM, and Kuwait is legislation.
payload.longDescription: Dike 将 ChatGPT 连接到沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋、卡塔尔、科威特和埃及的阿拉伯语及英语一手法律来源。搜索法律法规、法院裁决和教法意见（fatwa）。获取引用已检索来源原文的答案。可将法律编号和年份等引文解析为对应文档，并沿引文关系图检查法律是否已修订或废止。答案会在返回前依据检索到的来源进行核查，无法验证的主张将被省略。各国覆盖范围不同。例如，当前阿联酋资料为 DIFC 和 ADGM 的法院判决及规则，科威特资料则为法律法规。

payload.name: MatchLah
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your MatchLah parent or tutor account to arrange Singapore-focused tuition. Parents can prepare and submit private tutor requests and check their status. Tutors can create a profile, update it while pending review, and preview and save an optional profile photo. Review each draft before confirming submission to MatchLah.

Online lessons can connect parents, learners and tutors overseas. In-person lessons take place in Singapore. Rates are in Singapore dollars, with lesson time zones confirmed. Requests and profiles require admin review; submission does not guarantee approval, tutor contact or an assignment.

The connector collects lesson details and optional non-medical educational preferences. Do not provide diagnoses, medical or disability details, government identifiers, payment-card data or authentication secrets. Tutor gender is disclosed for public-profile matching; photos are optional profile images, not identity verification or biometric analysis.

Photo transfer depends on the host, with a private upload link as a fallback. Optional editing depends on the chat application. Approved tutor profiles and changes to submitted parent requests use the website or support.
payload.longDescription:
将你的 MatchLah 家长或导师账户连接起来，安排专注新加坡的辅导。家长可以准备并提交私人导师请求，查看请求状态；导师可以创建个人档案，在审核期间更新档案，并预览和保存可选的个人照片。向 MatchLah 提交前，请先审阅每份草稿。

在线课程可以连接海外家长、学习者和导师。线下课程在新加坡进行。费用以新加坡元计，课程时区会确认。请求和档案均需管理员审核；提交不保证获批、导师联系或成功匹配。

连接器会收集课程详情和可选的非医疗教育偏好。请勿提供诊断、医疗或残障详情、政府身份标识、支付卡数据或身份验证密钥。导师性别会为公开档案匹配而披露；照片是可选的档案图片，不用于身份验证或生物特征分析。

照片传输取决于主机，必要时会使用私密上传链接作为备用。可选编辑取决于聊天应用。已批准的导师档案以及对已提交家长请求的更改，请通过网站或支持渠道进行。

payload.name: CleverPrep Interview Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find CleverPrep's published company-and-role interview research and editorial practice questions. Search for a matching guide and retrieve relevant sections to support a preparation plan or public practice discussion in ChatGPT. Optional original-guide links provide source attribution. Practice questions are not confirmed employer questions. This plugin provides two read-only research tools; it has no checkout or payment operation.
payload.longDescription: 查找 CleverPrep 发布的公司和职位面试研究及编辑团队练习题。在 ChatGPT 中搜索匹配指南并获取相关章节，用于准备计划或公开练习讨论。可选的原始指南链接提供来源归属。练习题不代表已确认的雇主面试题。本插件提供两个只读研究工具，不包含结账或付款操作。

payload.name: Egleze
payload.description: 搜索经核实的播客新闻
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Egleze helps users search attribution-verified podcast moments, browse the latest coverage by topic, inspect published episode summaries and key points, and discover covered shows with canonical links back to Egleze.
payload.longDescription: Egleze 帮助用户搜索带有来源核验的播客片段、按主题浏览最新报道、查看已发布的节目摘要和要点，并发现相关节目及其指向 Egleze 的规范链接。

payload.name: ChildEdu Studio
payload.description: 创建可打印的学习材料
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChildEdu Studio guides teachers, parents, and therapists through creating printable educational materials in multiple languages. Users select the material language, material type, and learning content, then receive a generated file ready to preview and download.
payload.longDescription: ChildEdu Studio 帮助教师、家长和治疗师制作多语言可打印教育材料。用户选择材料语言、材料类型和学习内容，随后即可获得生成的文件，以供预览和下载。

payload.name: FootballGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FootballGPT helps football coaches use their saved coaching setup (age group, format, club type, formation, experience, qualifications, priorities and squad shape) to get coaching advice, build structured training sessions, search a practice library, and create saved animated practices. Player names, ages, shirt numbers and notes never leave FootballGPT through this app. Coaches remain responsible for reviewing and adapting every recommendation for their players.
payload.longDescription: FootballGPT 帮助足球教练使用已保存的执教设置（年龄组、比赛形式、俱乐部类型、阵型、经验、资质、优先事项和球队阵容情况），获取执教建议、制定结构化训练课程、搜索训练活动库并创建已保存的动画训练活动。球员姓名、年龄、球衣号码和备注不会通过此应用离开 FootballGPT。教练仍需负责审核并根据球员情况调整所有建议。

payload.name: Any Topic Academy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create a personalized course on any topic, learn through adaptive lessons, take quizzes and assessments, and track mastered concepts, gaps, and progress. Continue from another chat or device with your personal code.
payload.longDescription: 为任何主题创建个性化课程，通过自适应课节学习、参加测验和评估，并追踪已掌握的概念、知识缺口和学习进度。使用个人代码，即可在其他聊天或设备上继续学习。

payload.name: poitoko (ポイトコ)
payload.description: 把发现的片段投进 poitoko
payload.summaryOriginal: 見つけたかけらをポイトコにポイする
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ポイトコは、会話の中で見つけた大切な情報を残しておけるパーソナルライブラリです。メモ、要約、引用、リスト、ウェブ記事の抜粋などを、ポイトコに直接保存できます。「これをポイトコに保存して」や「これポイして」と話しかけるだけで、あとからポイトコアプリで読み返せます。

poitoko helps you keep useful information from your conversations. Save notes, summaries, quotes, lists, and web excerpts directly to your personal Poitoko library. Just say “save this to poitoko” or “poi this,” and it will be available in the poitoko app for later reading and reflection.
payload.longDescription:
poitoko 是您的个人资料库，可保存您在对话中发现的重要信息。您可以将笔记、摘要、引文、列表和网页文章摘录直接保存到 poitoko。只需说“把这个保存到 poitoko”或“把这个丢进 poitoko”，之后就可以在 poitoko 应用中重新阅读。

poitoko 帮助您保存对话中的有用信息。将笔记、摘要、引文、列表和网页摘录直接保存到个人 Poitoko 资料库。只需说“把这个保存到 poitoko”或“把这个投进去”，之后即可在 poitoko 应用中阅读和回顾。

payload.name: Policy Scope
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Japanese policy documents in Policy Scope and review document text, sources, related materials, ministries, councils, and meeting information. All tools are read-only and cannot create, modify, or delete data.
payload.longDescription: 在 Policy Scope 中搜索日本政策文件，并查看文件文本、来源、相关材料、主管部门、委员会和会议资料。所有工具均为只读，无法创建、修改或删除数据。

payload.name: Polyglot Cards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Load your Polyglot Cards vocabulary, teaching preferences, optional recent lesson recaps, and lesson choices in one preparation step. Practise Recall, Build a Sentence, or Conversation using familiar vocabulary or words selected from actual recent review successes, struggles, or first introductions. Save an agreed mixed batch of words, phrases, and grammar cards with duplicate checks and safe retries. Recaps and closing flag checks remain optional. Manage existing cards and media on request. The app handles long-term spaced repetition. An account is required; voice and tool availability depend on your ChatGPT experience.
payload.longDescription: 通过一个准备步骤，加载 Polyglot Cards 词汇、教学偏好、可选的近期课程回顾以及课程选择。使用熟悉词汇或从近期实际复习中掌握、遇到困难或首次接触的词语进行回忆、造句或对话练习。经双方确认后，保存一批混合的单词、短语和语法卡片，并进行重复项检查和安全重试。课程回顾和结束时的标记检查均为可选。按要求管理现有卡片和媒体。该应用负责长期的间隔重复学习。需要账户；语音和工具的可用性取决于您的 ChatGPT 使用体验。

payload.name: Hill Monitor
payload.description: 搜索议会信息并管理提醒
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hill Monitor answers questions about Canadian Parliament. It searches House and Senate transcripts, Question Period, committee schedules, the Canada Gazette, government news, press conferences, bills, the Order Paper, Orders in Council, MP and senator posts, and ministerial office staff. Signed-in users can list their phrase alerts, see recent hits, and create a new alert.
payload.longDescription: Hill Monitor 可回答有关加拿大议会的问题。它会搜索众议院和参议院记录、质询时间、委员会日程、Canada Gazette、政府新闻、新闻发布会、法案、议事日程、枢密令、议员和参议员帖子，以及部长办公室工作人员信息。登录用户可以查看短语提醒列表、查看近期命中情况并创建新提醒。

payload.name: Oboeru
payload.description: 会话英语转为复习卡片
payload.summaryOriginal: 会話の英語を復習カードに保存
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChatGPTで練習した英語表現を、日本語と英語のフラッシュカードとして自分のOboeruアカウントに保存します。瞬間英作文の練習手順、接続確認、保存先デッキの一覧表示に対応します。カード登録にはOboeruアカウントへのログインと連携許可が必要です。保存したカードはOboeruのWebアプリで復習できます。既存カード本文や学習履歴の読み取りには対応していません。
payload.longDescription: 将你在 ChatGPT 中练习的英语表达，以日英双语闪卡的形式保存到自己的 Oboeru 账户。支持即时造句练习流程、连接确认和查看保存目标卡组。添加卡片需要登录并授权连接 Oboeru 账户。保存的卡片可在 Oboeru Web 应用中复习。不支持读取现有卡片内容或学习记录。

payload.name: SimpleFeed News Free MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The SimpleFeed News Free MCP brings rights-cleared summary content into OpenAI. Search hundreds of premium publishers by topic, outlet, publisher, metadata date and more. Get article summariesin HTML, markdown and vectors for your testing prior to upgrading the paid version. Sign in with your existing free SimpleFeed account. This listing does not include full article text from SimpleFeed News & Video MCP.
payload.longDescription: SimpleFeed News Free MCP 将已获授权的摘要内容引入 OpenAI。通过主题、来源、出版商、元数据日期等条件搜索数百家优质出版社。提供 HTML、Markdown 和向量格式的文章摘要，供升级付费版本前进行测试。需使用现有免费 SimpleFeed 账户登录。本产品不包含来自 SimpleFeed News & Video MCP 的完整文章内容。

payload.name: FluoTest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FluoTest helps authenticated users create scored quiz drafts, inspect quiz questions and settings, review aggregate results, update quiz content, publish quizzes, and delete quizzes with an explicit confirmation step.
payload.longDescription: FluoTest帮助已认证用户创建评分测验草稿，检查测验问题和设置，查看汇总结果，更新测验内容，发布测验，并需经过明确确认步骤才能删除测验。

payload.name: Sudoku by Puzzle Fuel
payload.description: 每日数独挑战，边玩边学
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get today's puzzle at any of six difficulties — from Beginner to Diabolical — on a board you can actually play, or generate a fresh puzzle whenever you want one. More importantly, learn how to solve: every hint names the real technique in play and teaches you to spot it yourself, drawn from our Sudoku University teaching program and its twenty-technique glossary.
payload.longDescription: 在可实际游玩的棋盘上，以六种难度（从初级到地狱级）获取今日谜题，或随时生成全新谜题。更重要的是，学习解题技巧：每个提示会明确指出实际使用的技巧，并教你自行识别，这些技巧均来自我们的数独大学教学计划及其二十种技巧的术语表。

payload.name: Carnet de Padres
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Carnet de Padres helps adult parents and caregivers find Spanish-language educational resources for everyday family life. Explore 35 age-based routes from pregnancy to age 18 and 18 Alma activities about emotions and living together. Search by topic and age, read a practical action, an adaptable phrase or an activity, and check the source. Five resources also include attributed complementary readings from external institutions. These selections do not imply institutional review or endorsement. These resources provide educational guidance, not diagnosis, treatment or clinical assessment. Alma adaptations do not claim accredited professional review. The plugin does not manage accounts, purchases or access to private courses or books.
payload.longDescription:
Carnet de Padres 帮助成年父母及照顾者寻找用于日常家庭生活的西班牙语教育资源。
从怀孕到18岁提供35个按年龄划分的路径，以及18个关于情绪与共同生活的Alma活动。
按主题和年龄搜索，阅读实用行动指南、可调整的表达方式或活动内容，并查看资料来源。
其中5项资源包含来自外部机构的附加阅读材料。
以上选择不代表任何机构的审核或认可。
这些资源仅提供教育指导，不构成诊断、治疗或临床评估。
Alma改编内容不声称经过专业认证审核。
该插件不负责管理账户、购买行为或私人课程与书籍的访问权限。

payload.name: Nanan Legal Research
payload.description: 验证科特迪瓦法律来源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Nanan’s curated Côte d’Ivoire and OHADA legal corpus. Retrieve source text and provenance, verify article citations and quoted wording, and inspect exact corpus coverage with canonical links. Results are legal information, not legal advice.
payload.longDescription: 搜索Nanan整理的科特迪瓦及OHADA法律语料库。获取原文本及来源信息，验证条款引用和引用内容，通过规范链接检查语料库具体覆盖范围。结果为法律信息，而非法律建议。

payload.name: PTD Today Cosmos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PTD Today Cosmos lets you explore questions as connected systems. Ask about a topic and follow related stations, evidence, relationships, and scenario paths to understand how changes can ripple across technologies, markets, organizations, places, and time.
payload.longDescription: PTD Today Cosmos 让您能够将问题视为相互关联的系统来探索。提出某个主题相关的问题，通过相关节点、证据、关系和情景路径，理解变化如何在技术、市场、组织、地点和时间维度产生连锁反应。

payload.name: Mini Course Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and manage courses in your Mini Course Generator account. Draft modules and lessons, publish them for learners, organize course content, and review learner progress and quiz responses. You can also import media and manage course access for learners.
payload.longDescription: 在您的 Mini Course Generator 账户中创建和管理课程。草拟模块和课时，发布给学习者，整理课程内容，并查看学习者进度和测验反馈。您还可以导入媒体并管理学习者的课程访问权限。

payload.name: Nerdy
payload.description: 保存学习内容，稍后复习。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nerdy keeps the understanding you want to remember. Plan a learning pathway, learn one concept at a time with your AI tutor, and save the explanation that clicked after you explicitly agree. Return in a new conversation to revise from your saved Kites, record recall evidence, and see when to come back. You can also clarify and approve corrections to a specific Kite or create a compact chapter Review Sheet. Nerdy stores your learning record and source references; it does not receive source files or import full chat history. AI-authored content can be wrong, and grounding labels do not verify accuracy. Requires a Nerdy account.
payload.longDescription:
Nerdy会保存你想要记住的理解内容。
规划学习路径，通过AI导师逐个概念学习，并在你明确同意后保存产生顿悟的解释。
在新对话中返回即可复习已保存的Kites，记录回忆证据，并查看何时回来复习。
你也可以对特定Kites进行澄清和批准修正，或创建简洁的章节复习提纲。
Nerdy会存储你的学习记录和来源引用；它不会接收源文件或导入完整聊天记录。
AI生成的内容可能有误，基础标签无法验证准确性。
需要Nerdy账户。

payload.name: Retri
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Retri turns useful things you learn with an AI assistant into durable spaced-repetition cards and schedules each review when it will help most. Create guided decks, add consistent cards with optional Markdown, review due cards interactively, edit your library, and track your learning progress.
payload.longDescription: Retri将你与AI助手学习到的有用内容转化为持久的间隔重复卡片，并在最有助于巩固的时候安排每次复习。创建引导式卡片组，通过可选的Markdown添加一致性的卡片，以互动方式复习待复习的卡片，编辑你的卡片库，并追踪学习进度。

payload.name: Mataró
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find published news about Mataró, upcoming local events, and recent information on trains, traffic, public notices, weather, and air quality. News and event results link to Mataró.fm, where their sources are listed. Live information includes observation times and may not cover every disruption.
payload.longDescription: 获取关于马塔罗的已发布新闻、本地活动预告，以及火车班次、交通状况、公告信息、天气和空气质量的最新动态。新闻与活动信息结果会链接至Mataró.fm，其来源列表可在该网站查看。实时信息包含观测时间，但可能无法涵盖所有中断情况。

payload.name: Sophie Tutor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sophie Tutor opens an interactive AP Calculus lesson next to the chat. Each lesson moves one step at a time: an animation shows the idea, a short text explains it, and multiple-choice questions check understanding. A wrong answer explains the mistake and lets the student try again; a right answer shows why it is right. At the end, the student sees a short summary and a score.

Lessons cover AP Calculus AB and BC topics: limits and continuity, average and instantaneous rates of change, derivatives from the definition, the product rule, the chain rule, higher derivatives, L’Hôpital’s rule, optimization, u-substitution, definite integrals on a calculator, differential equations from word problems, and area in polar coordinates.

It is for high-school students who take AP Calculus, and for anyone who wants to review a calculus topic visually. Sophie Tutor only opens a lesson when one matches the topic; for other topics, ChatGPT helps as usual. It needs no account and collects no personal information.
payload.longDescription:
Sophie Tutor在聊天界面旁打开交互式AP微积分课程。每节课逐步推进：动画展示概念，简短文字解释原理，选择题检测理解程度。答错时会解释错误原因并允许学生重新尝试；答对时会说明正确理由。课程结束时学生可看到简要总结和得分。

课程涵盖AP微积分AB和BC课程内容：极限与连续性、平均变化率与瞬时变化率、定义法求导数、乘积法则、链式法则、高阶导数、洛必达法则、优化问题、u替换积分法、计算器计算定积分、由实际问题构建微分方程、极坐标下的面积计算等。

适用于学习AP微积分的高中生，以及希望通过视觉化方式复习微积分概念的人群。当话题匹配时Sophie Tutor会打开对应课程；其他话题则继续使用常规的ChatGPT功能。无需账户且不收集任何个人信息。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Interactive AP Calculus lessons, Multiple-choice practice with explanations

payload.name: The Living Bread
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Meet Christ and your family in Christ. The Living Bread is a Christian community. With this plugin, ChatGPT reads Scripture word for word from a stored public domain Bible, never generated; finds the verses the house pairs with what you carry, grief, fear, anxiety, loneliness, gratitude; answers honest questions about Jesus, forgiveness, suffering and how to begin, from Scripture; finds real churches and gatherings near any city, from Seattle to Lagos to Madrid, with service times when known; shows the Tables where real people are talking and praying right now, the prayers believers have left at places near you, the gospel in the house's own words, and the doors of the Christian heritage: denominations, saints, sacred sites, the people and places of the Bible. Signed in, it reads only for you: the prayers real people have prayed over you by name, in their own voices, with the door to hear each one; the prayers you gave and how they are going; what you said yes to; your family circles and next gatherings. This plugin is read only. It never prays in your name, never records or sends anything, and never writes to your account; every act of prayer and reply happens in the app itself, by your own hand. Everything points to Jesus Christ.
payload.longDescription:
在《生命之粮》中遇见基督和你的基督家庭。
《生命之粮》是一个基督教社群。
通过此插件，ChatGPT会逐字阅读存储的公共领域圣经内容，从不生成；根据您所承载的悲伤、恐惧、焦虑、孤独、感恩等情感，找到与之对应的经文；从圣经中回答关于耶稣、宽恕、苦难以及如何开始的诚实问题；查找任何城市的实际教会和聚会信息，从西雅图到拉各斯再到马德里，显示已知的礼拜时间；展示实时有人祷告和交谈的餐桌，信徒在您附近留下的祷告内容，以房屋自身语言表达的福音，以及基督教传统之门：教派、圣人、圣地、圣经中的人物和地点。
已登录状态下，仅为您阅读：他人以自己声音为您姓名祷告的祷告内容，可聆听每一条祷告内容；您提交的祷告及其进展；您所同意的事物；您的家庭圈及下次聚会信息。
此插件为只读模式。
它从不以您的名义祷告，从不记录或发送任何内容，也从不写入您的账户；所有祷告与回应行为均在应用内完成，由您亲自操作。
一切皆指向耶稣基督。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read any Bible passage word for word from a stored text, Verses for what you are carrying, in your own words, Today's Daily Bread, the verse the whole family receives, The gospel in the house's own words, Honest answers about Jesus and faith, grounded in Scripture, Real churches near any place in the world, Prayer gatherings, Bible studies and communities to join, Tables live right now: real people talking and praying, Prayers left at places near you, and the prayer map, Christian heritage: denominations, saints, sacred sites, Bible places, Parables, miracles and teachings of Jesus, hymns, beliefs, holidays, Signed in: the prayers real people prayed over you, in their voices, Signed in: your day, your walk, your family and your invitations, Read only: it never writes, records or sends anything for you

payload.name: SBH News
payload.description: SBH News 最新文章和快讯
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SBH News가 공개 발행한 최신 기사와 속보를 읽고, 키워드로 기사를 검색하거나 기사 상세 내용과 운영 테마를 확인할 수 있습니다. 모든 결과에는 원문 링크가 포함되며 비공개 초안 조회, 콘텐츠 작성·수정·삭제, 발행 또는 메시지 전송은 지원하지 않습니다.
payload.longDescription: 您可以阅读SBH News公开发布的最新文章和快讯，通过关键词搜索文章，或查看文章详细内容及运营主题。所有结果均包含原文链接，但不支持查看非公开草稿、内容创建/编辑/删除、发布或发送消息。

payload.name: CollegeFill
payload.description: 整理大学个人资料数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CollegeFill prepares and validates privacy-scoped Master Profile JSON for manual import into the CollegeFill Chrome extension. It supports only five public sections: Academic, Test Scores, Courses & Grades, Activities & Extracurriculars, and Honors / Awards. It can report supported limits and run data-readiness checks for supported Common App and University of California application pages. The MCP is stateless and requires no CollegeFill account or OAuth connection. It does not access browser storage, log in to or control an application website, navigate, save, or submit an application. Users manually import the returned JSON into CollegeFill and review all data and page-specific checks before filling or saving any page.
payload.longDescription: CollegeFill生成并验证隐私范围的主资料JSON，供手动导入CollegeFill浏览器扩展程序。该工具仅支持五个公开部分：学术背景、考试成绩、课程与成绩、活动与课外经历，以及荣誉/奖项。它可以报告支持的限制并运行针对支持的Common App和加州大学申请页面的数据就绪性检查。MCP为无状态设计，无需CollegeFill账户或OAuth连接。它不会访问浏览器存储、登录或控制应用网站、导航、保存或提交申请。用户需将生成的JSON手动导入CollegeFill，在填写或保存任何页面前审查所有数据和页面特定检查。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List the five supported profile sections and target limits, Create privacy-scoped CollegeFill Master Profile JSON, Validate CollegeFill Master Profile JSON before import, Check supported profile data for Common App readiness, Check supported profile data for UC readiness

payload.name: English Exercises
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Practise English with existing grammar and vocabulary exercises inside ChatGPT. Find a topic and CEFR level, then complete gap-fill questions, sentence transformations or click-to-edit corrections. Get instant marking, hints, explanations and a final score with mistake review. Results stay in the current player; account progress is not saved. Dictation and audio practice are available on the website rather than through this plugin.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT内置的语法和词汇练习来练习英语。选择一个主题和CEFR等级，然后完成填空题、句型转换或点击编辑更正。即时评分、提示、解析及最终得分，并附带错误回顾。结果仅保存在当前会话中；账户进度不会保存。听力练习和音频练习仅在网站上提供，而非通过此插件。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find English exercises, Interactive English practice

payload.name: Parrot
payload.description: 在您的水平上练习西班牙语
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your Parrot Spanish level, streak, and vocabulary into ChatGPT, and save words you learn back to Parrot.

Parrot is a Spanish learning app. Once you connect your Parrot account, ChatGPT can see your Parrot level and the matching CEFR level, your day streak, and the Spanish words you are learning and already know. It uses them to pitch explanations, conversations, and quizzes at your level and around your own words.

When you ask, ChatGPT can save new Spanish words to your Parrot dictionary as learning or known, and count a real practice session toward your Parrot streak.

Who it's for: Parrot learners who want to practice Spanish in ChatGPT with the same level and vocabulary they use in the app.

Limitations: requires a Parrot account. Spanish only. ChatGPT cannot change your Parrot level, and it never sees your email, password, payment details, or listening history. You can disconnect at any time in Parrot under Settings, Connected Apps.
payload.longDescription:
将您的Parrot西班牙语水平、连续天数和词汇带入ChatGPT，并将您学习的单词保存回Parrot。

Parrot是一款西班牙语学习应用。连接您的Parrot账户后，ChatGPT可以查看您的Parrot水平和对应的CEFR级别、连续天数，以及您正在学习和已掌握的西班牙语单词。它会根据您的水平和词汇量提供匹配的解释、对话和测验。

当您请求时，ChatGPT可以将新西班牙语单词保存到您的Parrot词典中，标记为学习中或已掌握，并将一次真实练习计入您的Parrot连续天数。

适用对象：希望在ChatGPT中使用与应用内相同水平和词汇练习西班牙语的Parrot学习者。

限制条件：需要Parrot账户；仅支持西班牙语；ChatGPT无法修改您的Parrot水平，且不会查看您的电子邮件、密码、支付信息或听力记录；您可以在Parrot的设置-连接的应用中随时断开连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read Spanish level and streak, List learning and known words, Save words to Parrot, Record daily practice

payload.name: atlas
payload.description: 探索三维人体解剖结构
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore named structures in an interactive 3D anatomy atlas. Search anatomical names and identifiers, choose from detailed male, complete male, standard male, female, embryo and cell models, and open focused views with orbit, zoom, isolation, layers and cross-sections. Students, educators and curious learners can inspect individual organs and compare structures. Model coverage varies, and some reference models are partial. Atlas provides general anatomy education; it does not access patient records, interpret medical scans, diagnose conditions or recommend treatment. No Atlas account is required.
payload.longDescription: 在交互式3D解剖图谱中探索命名结构。搜索解剖学名称和标识符，从详细男性、完整男性、标准男性、女性、胚胎和细胞模型中选择，并开启支持旋转、缩放、隔离、图层和横截面的聚焦视图。学生、教育工作者和好奇的学习者可以检查单个器官并比较结构。模型覆盖范围各不相同，部分参考模型可能不完整。图谱提供基础解剖学教育；不访问患者记录、不解读医学扫描、不诊断病情或推荐治疗方案。无需Atlas账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search anatomy, Explore 3D anatomy, Isolate structures

payload.name: Soreno Mock Interviews
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Practice case and job interviews out loud with a realistic AI interviewer, right in ChatGPT.

Ask for a mock interview and Soreno picks a case for your target role, or search the case bank by firm, industry or topic (market sizing, profitability, M&A and more). Tap Start and talk it through by voice: the interviewer leads like a McKinsey, BCG or Bain interviewer, shares exhibits on screen when it's time and pushes on your math and structure. Behavioral, fit and finance technical rounds work the same way.

When you finish, Soreno scores you against an interviewer rubric and shows strengths, what to improve and concrete next steps, and ChatGPT can coach you on it. Your interviews and feedback stay in your Soreno account at app.soreno.ai.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中通过现实的AI面试官进行大声模拟面试。

请求模拟面试，Soreno会根据你的目标职位选择一个案例，或通过公司、行业或主题（市场测算、盈利能力、并购等）搜索案例库。
点击开始后通过语音进行模拟：面试官将像麦肯锡、BCG或贝恩的面试官一样引导，到相应环节会在屏幕显示图表，并对你的数学计算和逻辑结构进行深入追问。
行为面试、适配度评估和技术类金融环节的模拟方式相同。

完成面试后，Soreno将根据面试官评分标准为你打分，展示优势领域、待改进方向及具体提升步骤，ChatGPT可针对此进行辅导。
你的所有面试记录与反馈将保存在Soreno账户中，访问地址：app.soreno.ai。

payload.name: World War Watcher
payload.description: 引用伊朗-美国战争简报
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
World War Watcher tracks the Iran–US war and its effects on shipping, energy, cloud infrastructure and connectivity. Ask what happened on a given day or over a period, what a source reported and how credible it is, how intense the war is now and how that has changed, where US crude and the Strategic Petroleum Reserve stand, whether Gulf cloud regions and Red Sea and Hormuz cables are affected, or how many interceptors and missiles each side holds.

Every answer comes from World War Watcher's human-curated record: daily dispatches, a dated timeline of over 1,400 events with their sources, a registry of graded sources, and live feeds. Each result carries a link to the page it came from, so claims can be checked.

Limitations: it covers the Iran–US war only; it reads public data and changes nothing; the escalation score measures current intensity and is not a forecast; stockpile counts are curated estimates with a confidence grade and an assessment date; it gives no trading advice and does not predict strikes. Data is licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.
payload.longDescription:
World War Watcher追踪伊朗-美国战争及其对航运、能源、云基础设施和连接性的影响。您可以询问某一天或一段时间内发生了什么，某来源报告的内容及其可信度，当前战争的激烈程度及其变化情况，美国原油和战略石油储备的现状，波斯湾云区域以及红海和霍尔木兹电缆是否受到影响，以及双方各自持有的拦截弹和导弹数量。

所有回答均来自World War Watcher的人工整理记录：每日简报、超过1400个事件的带日期时间线及其来源、分级来源登记册和实时信息流。每个结果都会附带指向原始页面的链接，以便核实相关声明。

限制条件：仅涵盖伊朗-美国战争；仅读取公开数据且不进行任何更改；升级评分用于衡量当前激烈程度，而非预测未来；库存数量为人工整理的估算值，附带可信度评级和评估日期；不提供交易建议，也不预测袭击事件。数据采用CC BY-NC 4.0许可。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search dispatches and region profiles, Read cited passages, Search the dated event timeline, Search the graded source registry, Escalation score and trend, US oil supply and SPR, Gulf cloud, connectivity and cable status, Curated weapon stockpiles, Situation card

payload.name: Confetto Mock Interviews
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Practice your medical school, residency or health-program interview out loud with a realistic AI interviewer, right in ChatGPT.

Ask for a mock interview and Confetto picks a question for your program (MMI ethics, personal, policy, teamwork and more), or choose one from the question bank. Tap Start and answer by voice: the interviewer asks natural follow-ups like a real admissions panel. When you finish, Confetto scores your answer against an admissions rubric and shows what went well, what to improve and a full breakdown, and ChatGPT can coach you on it.

Works for medical school (MD/DO, MMI and traditional), residency (including CaRMS), PA, dental, vet, nursing, pharmacy, PT and OT programs. Your interviews and feedback stay in your Confetto account at app.confetto.ai.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中，通过逼真的AI面试官，出声练习医学专业、住院医师或健康项目面试。

请求模拟面试后，Confetto会为你的项目（MMI伦理问题、个人问题、政策问题、团队合作等）选取题目，或从题库中自主选择。
点击开始后通过语音作答：面试官会像真实招生委员会一样提出自然的后续问题。
完成面试后，Confetto将根据招生评分标准对你的回答进行打分，展示优势所在、需改进之处及详细分析，ChatGPT还可针对内容进行辅导。

适用于医学专业（MD/DO、MMI及传统模式）、住院医师（含CaRMS）、 Physician Assistant（PA）、牙科、兽医、护理、药学、物理治疗（PT）和职业治疗（OT）项目。
您的面试记录和反馈将保存在app.confetto.ai的Confetto账户中。

payload.name: TeachMe.To
payload.description: 找到您附近的下一位教练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find sports and music lessons with TeachMe.To. Search by skill, city or postal code, learner age and experience, lesson length, budget, and dates. Compare coaches using public teaching information and reviews, and explore current lesson times. Open the lesson finder from ChatGPT or use it during your conversation. No TeachMe.To account is needed to browse. This plugin does not book, reserve, charge, message coaches, or manage accounts. Parents and guardians can search for lessons for their children. Availability can change and browsing does not confirm a lesson.

通过TeachMe.To寻找体育和音乐课程。

payload.name: uNotes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
uNotes is a study library of university course materials — past exams, assignments, lab reports and lecture notes, organized by school and course. The uNotes plugin gives ChatGPT read access to that library and to the user's own study data: it can search the library, open a document and read its full text, list the user's flashcard decks and quizzes, look up their study streak, check how much of their monthly quota is left, and list the schools and courses they follow.

Every tool is read-only. The plugin exposes eight tools, all declared readOnlyHint:true / destructiveHint:false / idempotentHint:true, and none of them create, edit or delete anything in a uNotes account. Typical use is asking a question about material the user already has — "what do my Biology notes say about cell structure", "which courses am I following", "how long is my study streak" — and letting ChatGPT pull the answer out of the underlying documents.

Access is authorized with OAuth 2.1: PKCE (S256) with dynamic client registration, an explicit consent screen, and seven granular read scopes (search, documents, flashcards, quizzes, study, profile, library) plus offline_access. Tools are registered per request against the scopes the token actually carries, so a grant that omits a scope makes the matching tools invisible rather than merely blocked. Requests are rate-limited per user, and tools never accept a user identifier as input — every call is scoped to the authenticated account's own data.
payload.longDescription:
uNotes是大学课程资料的学习资料库，包含过往考试、作业、实验报告和讲义笔记，按学校和课程分类。uNotes插件为ChatGPT提供对资料库和用户个人学习数据的只读访问权限：它可以搜索资料库、打开文档并读取全文、列出用户的闪卡套件和测验、查看学习连续天数、检查当月配额剩余量，并列出用户关注的学校和课程。

所有工具均为只读模式。插件暴露了八个工具，均声明为readOnlyHint:true / destructiveHint:false / idempotentHint:true，且这些工具不会在uNotes账户中创建、编辑或删除任何内容。典型用法是向ChatGPT提出关于用户已有资料的问题——例如「我的生物笔记中关于细胞结构说了什么」、「我正在学习哪些课程」、「我的学习连续天数有多长」——然后由ChatGPT从底层文档中提取答案。

授权通过OAuth 2.1实现：使用PKCE（S256）和动态客户端注册、显式同意界面，以及七个细粒度只读作用域（搜索、文档、闪卡、测验、学习、个人资料、资料库）加上offline_access。每个请求会根据令牌实际携带的作用域注册工具，因此若授权缺少某作用域，对应工具将不可见而非仅被阻止。每个用户的请求受速率限制，且工具从不接受用户标识符作为输入——每次调用均限定于已认证账户的自身数据。

payload.name: Biohacking Kompakt
payload.description: 关于补充剂的研究现状
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Biohacking Kompakt ist eine deutschsprachige Faktencheck-Datenbank zu Supplements, Peptiden, Therapien und Longevity-Themen. Zu jedem Thema gibt es den BK-Score: fünf Achsen, die den Wissensstand beschreiben – wie gut am Menschen untersucht, wie gut die Sicherheitslage untersucht ist, wie lange und breit angewendet, wie plausibel der Mechanismus und wie groß der Hype. Dazu die Richtung, in die die vorhandene Evidenz zeigt, und die passende Folge des Podcasts „Biohacking Kompakt“.

Der Score bewertet den Wissensstand, nicht die Substanz. Die App liest live von biohackingkompakt.de, verkauft nichts und gibt keine medizinische Beratung. Zu verschreibungspflichtigen und nicht zugelassenen Substanzen liefert sie ausschließlich die Einordnung der Studienlage – ohne Dosierung, ohne Anwendung, ohne Bezugsquelle.
payload.longDescription:
Biohacking Kompakt是一个德语事实核查数据库，涵盖补充剂、肽、疗法和抗衰老主题。每个主题均配有BK评分：五个评估维度分别反映研究程度（人体实验验证情况）、安全研究程度、应用时长与广度、作用机制合理性以及市场热度。同时展示现有证据的指向方向，并推荐配套播客节目。

评分仅评估知识体系完备性，不涉及物质本身价值。应用实时从biohackingkompakt.de获取数据，不进行任何销售，不提供医疗建议。对于处方药及未获批准的物质，仅提供研究现状归类，不涉及剂量指导、使用方法或购买渠道。

payload.name: Anatomy
payload.description: 在ChatGPT中查看三维人体解剖结构
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Anatomy opens an interactive 3D human body inside ChatGPT. Ask about a muscle, bone, nerve, joint or organ and ChatGPT frames it, fades whatever covers it, and labels what matters. Peel away muscle layers, cut through the body, isolate a structure, colour-code what belongs together, and play movements like bending, squatting or lifting a knee. Anatomy can also draw a muscle's line of pull across the hip or knee, so you can watch a muscle change its job as the joint moves. Tap anything to ask about it, mark where something hurts, or ask for a quick find-it quiz. Anatomy shows reference anatomy for learning and explanation; it does not diagnose or give medical advice.
payload.longDescription: Anatomy可在ChatGPT内打开一个交互式3D人体模型。向ChatGPT询问肌肉、骨骼、神经、关节或器官时，系统会将其突出显示，隐藏遮挡物并标注关键部位。可逐层剥离肌肉、切割身体、隔离特定结构、用颜色区分关联部位，并演示弯曲、深蹲或抬膝等动作。Anatomy还能在髋关节或膝关节上绘制肌肉的拉力线，让您观察肌肉随关节运动改变功能的动态过程。轻触任何部位即可了解相关信息，标记疼痛位置或参与快速找茬测试。Anatomy提供用于学习和讲解的解剖参考内容；本功能不用于疾病诊断或提供医疗建议。

payload.name: Endless U
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn any topic into a course, chat through lessons until you understand. 1 on 1 teaching with AI.

Tell Endless U what you want to learn, and ChatGPT drafts a structured course just for you: real modules, bite-sized lessons, and a teacher that adapts as you go. Ask questions, go deeper, or slow down. It's a conversation with your private tutor, ChatGPT.

Pick up exactly where you left off, even weeks later, without searching through your chat history.

Every lesson you finish earns points and builds your streak, so momentum turns into a habit instead of another abandoned tab. 

Browse courses other learners have built, or make yours public and share your progress. Your streak becomes something worth showing off.

Curious about something? Don't just ask ChatGPT about it. Learn it, properly, one lesson at a time with Endless U.

payload.name: 実習の味方（認証付き）
payload.description: 面向授权用户的护理实习支持
payload.summaryOriginal: 許可ユーザー向けの看護実習サポート
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 許可された看護学生が、看護実習での出来事や気持ちを一段階ずつ整理し、次の実習で試せる一歩を考えるための認証付きサポートです。患者さんや施設を特定できる情報は入力しないでください。会話内容は認証サーバーへ送信・保存しません。
payload.longDescription: 这是为获得授权的护理专业学生提供的认证支持服务，帮助用户逐步梳理护理实习中的经历与感受，并思考可应用于下一次实习的改进步骤。请勿输入可识别患者或医疗机构的信息，对话内容不会被发送至认证服务器进行存储。

payload.name: Analytics Power Hour Librarian
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analytics Power Hour Librarian searches the full transcript archive of the Analytics Power Hour podcast. Users ask what the hosts and guests have said about an analytics topic and get quoted passages, each cited with the episode number, title, timestamp, and link. Users can also ask about the archive itself, such as the latest episode or which episodes came out in a given year.
payload.longDescription: Analytics Power Hour Librarian可搜索《Analytics Power Hour》播客的完整文字稿存档。用户可询问主持人和嘉宾对某一分析主题的讨论，并获取引用内容，每段引用均附有集数、标题、时间戳和链接。用户还可询问存档相关问题，例如最新集数或某年发布的集数列表。

payload.name: JusticeNow Library
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
JusticeNow Library brings the Chilean legal corpus into ChatGPT: rulings from the Supreme Court, the Courts of Appeals and first-instance courts; statutes, decrees and codes from the Library of Congress; Constitutional Court decisions; administrative rulings from the Comptroller General, the Labor Directorate, the tax authority (SII), the financial regulator (CMF) and the Superintendencies; and academic legal scholarship.

Ask in plain language and ChatGPT searches the corpus, opens the official document and answers with the full citation —docket number, date, court or agency— and a link to the source, so every statement can be verified. Nothing is quoted without opening the document.

Requires a JusticeNow account with a plan that includes Library. Searches draw down that plan's credits; opening documents is free.
payload.longDescription:
JusticeNow Library将智利法律文献库引入ChatGPT：包含最高法院、上诉法院及初审法院的裁判文书；国会图书馆的法规、法令及法典；宪法法院的裁决；审计长办公室、劳动局、国家税务局（SII）、金融监管局（CMF）及各监管局的行政裁决；以及学术界的法律研究成果。

用通俗语言提问，ChatGPT将搜索法律文献库，打开官方文件并提供完整引用信息——包括案号、日期、法院或机构名称以及来源链接，确保每项陈述均可验证。所有引用均需先打开文件确认。

需要拥有包含文献库权限的JusticeNow账户，搜索操作将消耗该计划的信用点，而打开文档本身免费。

payload.name: Tito
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tito is Twinbook's study assistant. Ask ChatGPT to push a paper, article, link, YouTube video or its own research notes into one of your Twinbook spaces, and Twinbook turns it into structured notes, quizzes and flashcards. Figures, sources and structure are kept, and long documents are split at section boundaries within your plan's limits.
payload.longDescription: Tito是Twinbook的学习助手。您可让ChatGPT将论文、文章、链接、YouTube视频或其自身研究笔记推送到Twinbook的任一空间中，Twinbook会将其转化为结构化笔记、测验和记忆卡片。图表、来源和结构都会被保留，而长文档会在您的计划限制范围内按章节边界进行拆分。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Save a paper or article into a study space, Import a public link or YouTube video, Save ChatGPT research notes as a document, Check remaining plan allowance before importing

payload.name: 3GPP Scout
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 3GPP Scout helps telecom engineers, standards delegates and consultants search its own index of public 3GPP specifications, meeting contributions (TDocs), decisions and company positions. Find a clause or recorded outcome, then check a short excerpt with its document number, version and source link. Review and confirm targets to follow a topic in your Scout account, with optional email digests. Requires a Scout account and uses its request limits. Coverage varies by release and working group; a proposal is not an agreed outcome. Purchases are not available inside the plugin. 3GPP Scout is an independent product and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by 3GPP, ETSI or any 3GPP Organizational Partner. 3GPP™ is a trade mark of ETSI registered for the benefit of its Members and of the 3GPP Organizational Partners. Excerpts are quoted for reference and the official documents govern. Copyright, correction or removal requests: contact@3gppscout.com.

payload.name: Servanta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research monitored print, web, TV, radio, and transcript coverage in your organization's Servanta archive. Search exact terms or concepts, retrieve full articles, compare coverage, and prepare source-linked summaries. Results are limited to content available to the connected Servanta account.
payload.longDescription: 在您组织的Servanta档案库中研究监控的印刷媒体、网络、电视、广播和文字稿覆盖情况。搜索精确术语或概念，获取完整文章，比较覆盖情况，并生成带来源链接的摘要。结果仅限于已连接的Servanta账户可访问的内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search monitored media, Retrieve full articles

payload.name: Classic Audioguide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover published museum exhibitions, browse localized exhibit information, access audio-guide content, and identify an exhibit from a visitor-provided photo. Nearby search can use an approximate city-level location. Photo identification sends the visitor photo and selected catalog information to Google Gemini for matching.
payload.longDescription:
发现已发布的博物馆展览，浏览本地化展览信息，访问音频导览内容，并通过游客提供的照片识别展品。
附近搜索可使用大致的城市级别位置。
照片识别功能会将游客照片和选定的目录信息发送至Google Gemini进行匹配。

payload.name: Great Question
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Great Question puts your whole research workflow inside ChatGPT and Codex. Create research studies, recruit participants, and pull what customers said, without leaving the chat. All backed by verbatim quotes you can trace to the session.

You don't need to know which study holds the answer. Ask "What have customers said about our checkout in the last six months?" and it searches your transcripts, highlights and insights, then comes back with quotes, so everyone on your team makes research-backed decisions with confidence.

It works the other way too. Describe what you want to learn and it sets up the study, an interview, survey or prototype test, with the screener, incentive and participants ready for you to review.

Your existing Great Question permissions apply, so it only sees what you can see.
payload.longDescription:
Great Question将整个研究工作流程整合至ChatGPT和Codex中。创建研究项目、招募参与者并提取客户原话，全程无需离开聊天界面。所有内容均配有可追溯至原始会话的原话引用。

您无需知道哪项研究包含答案。询问「过去六个月客户对我们结账流程有何评价？」系统将搜索您的对话记录、重点内容和洞察，返回相关原话引用，确保团队成员都能自信地做出基于研究的决策。

反向操作同样适用。描述您想了解的内容，系统将自动设置研究方案——包括访谈、问卷调查或原型测试，并准备好筛选问卷、激励措施和参与者供您审核。

您现有的Great Question权限设置将被保留，因此系统仅能访问您有权查看的内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search what customers said, Pull top complaints with quotes, Read transcripts and highlights, Create research studies and screeners, Shortlist and invite participants, Set interview availability

payload.name: DSTI School of Engineering
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Apply to DSTI School of Engineering with guided support in ChatGPT. Explore programmes and entry requirements, start or resume an application, review what remains, prepare updates, and submit only after your explicit confirmation. Approved study-abroad agencies can also support applicants they represent. Guidance comes directly from DSTI's application system. Documents, identity checks, payments and restricted personal information remain within the secure DSTI Application Portal.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT的指导支持申请DSTI工程学院。探索课程及入学要求，启动或继续申请，审查剩余事项，准备更新内容，并在您明确确认后提交。经批准的海外留学机构也可为其所代表的申请人提供支持。所有指导信息均直接来自DSTI申请系统。文件、身份验证、付款及受限个人信息均保留在安全的DSTI申请门户中。

payload.name: Perfume Picks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Perfume Picks looks up about 13,000 fragrances with note pyramids, accords, concentration, community longevity, sillage and compliment scores, and list price. Ask what smells like a designer scent for less and get curated dupes with a match percentage and the price difference. Compare two fragrances side by side, get picks from the notes you like with a budget and an occasion, or ask what to wear tonight. Wear scores are community ratings, and list prices are the brand's MSRP. Perfume Picks is read-only: it doesn't sell anything or see anyone's personal wardrobe.
payload.longDescription: Perfume Picks 可查询约13,000种香水的香调金字塔、调性、浓度、用户评价的持久度、扩散性及好评度，并显示建议零售价。询问哪些香水气味类似设计师香水但价格更亲民，并获取精选的替代品，包含匹配百分比及价格差异。可对比两种香水，根据您喜欢的香调、预算及场合获取推荐，或询问今晚该穿哪款香水。用户评价为社区评分，建议零售价为品牌方的MSRP。Perfume Picks 为只读模式：不销售任何产品，也不查看用户的个人香水收藏。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search fragrances, Find dupes, Compare fragrances, Recommendations

payload.name: Derive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Derive notebook to ChatGPT to search and ask about your handwritten STEM notes. Find relevant excerpts, list recent pages, read recognized page text, and inspect available page previews. Text results respect your access to pages, including shared pages. Page previews require an accessible saved thumbnail. The tools do not edit or delete notebook content. Recognized text can contain errors, and long page results can be truncated.
payload.longDescription:
将您的Derive笔记本连接至ChatGPT，可搜索并查询手写的STEM笔记。
查找相关摘录、列出最近页面、阅读已识别的页面文本，并查看可用的页面预览。
文本结果会尊重您对页面的访问权限，包括共享页面。
页面预览需要可访问的已保存缩略图。
这些工具不会编辑或删除笔记本内容。
已识别文本可能包含错误，且长页面结果可能被截断。

payload.name: Dopamine Club
payload.description: 肽类与认知增强剂研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore research on peptides, nootropics, supplements and other compounds inside ChatGPT. Look up retatrutide, BPC-157, L-Theanine or Bacopa to read Dopamine Club's published research, follow original study links and see what the community reports.

Compare two to four profiles, filter cited studies by source classification, and view available website scores, research grades, report counts, sentiment and reported effects or side effects. Source dates, review verdicts, missing data and disclosed text omissions remain visible.

Designed for general-audience educational research. Results come from a versioned Dopamine Club snapshot, not a live or exhaustive literature search. Community reports are anecdotes; counts represent classified mentions rather than unique people. Website scores do not measure clinical effectiveness, personal safety or the percentage of people helped. Administration guidance, promotional passages and unqualified safety claims are withheld; historical study doses are not recommendations. No diagnosis, treatment advice, dosing guidance, vendor recommendations or purchases.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT内部探索肽类、认知增强剂、补充剂及其他化合物的研究。
可查询Retatrutide、BPC-157、L-茶氨酸或 Bacopa，阅读Dopamine Club发布的研究成果，追踪原始研究链接并查看社区报告。

可对比两到四个资料档案，按来源分类筛选引用研究，并查看可用网站评分、研究评级、报告数量、情感倾向及报告中的效果或副作用。
来源日期、评审结论、缺失数据和披露文本遗漏部分仍会显示。

专为大众受众的教育性研究设计。
结果来自经过版本化的Dopamine Club快照，而非实时或全面的文献检索。
社区报告均为个人经历；数量仅表示分类提及次数而非独立个体。
网站评分不衡量临床有效性、个人安全性或受益人群比例。
不提供管理指南、宣传内容及未经验证的安全声明；历史研究剂量不构成建议。
不提供诊断、治疗建议、剂量指导、供应商推荐或购买行为。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search compound research, Read cited studies, Explore scores and community, Compare compound profiles

payload.name: SongDecoder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SongDecoder helps readers examine song lyrics through textual evidence. It separates what the lyrics state from interpretation, maps the speaker's frame and central conflict, and considers possible psychological mechanisms, alternative readings, and effects on listeners. It does not diagnose people or infer an artist's beliefs from a narrator's words. Music, vocal performance, and historical context are assessed only when that material is provided or otherwise available.

payload.name: SEND Parents Help
payload.description: 为家长提供的友好SEND帮助
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SEND Parents Help gives parents and carers in England clear, checked guidance on special educational needs and disabilities (SEND) and disability benefits for children and young people.

Ask about EHC needs assessments and EHCPs, SEN support at school, annual reviews, school places and school transport, and SEND Tribunal appeals. Or ask about Disability Living Allowance for children, PIP, Carer's Allowance, Attendance Allowance, Blue Badges, mandatory reconsiderations and benefit appeals.

What you can do:
- Get plain-English explanations of each step, including the deadlines that apply.
- Look up the exact wording of a question on supported benefit and SEND Tribunal forms, such as question 64 on the child DLA form, and get help putting your answer into words.
- Find your council's SEND contacts, local EHCP process and support services.
- Get help understanding a decision letter, report or form you have received.
- Ask questions about a SEND Parents Help article you are reading.

Answers come from the SEND Parents Help knowledge base, written from official guidance and legislation. Figures such as benefit rates and time limits come from a maintained register of facts, each with its source, rather than from memory.

SEND Parents Help is run by SEND Parents Help CIC, a Community Interest Company. The guidance covers England only and is general information, not legal advice. The tools only read our published guidance and need no account.
payload.longDescription:
SEND Parents Help为英格兰的家长和照护者提供关于特殊教育需求和残疾（SEND）以及儿童和青少年残疾福利的清晰核查指导。

可咨询教育健康护理评估和教育健康护理计划（EHCP），学校提供的特殊教育需求（SEN）支持，年度评审，学校名额和校车服务，以及SEND法庭上诉。
或咨询儿童残疾生活津贴、个人护理津贴（PIP）、照护者津贴、出席津贴、蓝色通行证、强制性重新考虑及福利上诉。

您可以：
- 获取每一步骤的通俗易懂解释，包括适用的截止日期。
- 查找支持福利和SEND法庭表格中具体问题的准确表述，例如儿童DLA表格中的第64题，并获得帮助将您的答案转化为文字。
- 查找您所在委员会的SEND联系人、当地EHCP流程和支持服务。
- 获得帮助理解您收到的决定信、报告或表格。
- 对您正在阅读的SEND Parents Help文章提出问题。

答案源自由官方指导和法规编写而成的SEND Parents Help知识库。
诸如福利金额和时限等数据来自维护中的事实登记册，每个数据均有来源标注，而非依赖记忆。

SEND Parents Help由SEND Parents Help CIC（社区利益公司）运营。
该指导仅适用于英格兰，为一般信息，不构成法律建议。
工具仅读取我们发布的指导内容，无需账户。

payload.name: Learn It
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Send a photo of a textbook page or a handwritten word list, attach a document, paste your notes, or just say what you want to practice. You get one short link that opens the quiz in Learn It, where you see every question before you add it.

Learn It is an app for practicing vocabulary and quiz questions on iPhone and iPad, used by more than 300,000 students, most of them in Sweden. Practicing there is different from being asked questions in a chat. For a decade, since 2016, the app has been refined around what you see, hear and feel at every answer: animation, sound and haptic feedback tuned to keep practice short, focused and rewarding. That is particularly helpful for students with learning challenges, who often find it hard to get started and to keep going. You practice with multiple choice, by writing the answers, or with flashcards.

Learn It also keeps track of what you have learned. It keeps a record of every word you practice and uses spaced repetition to show which words are due for review, at growing intervals, so you go back to them before you forget them.

There is no account and nothing to sign in to. On a device without the app, the link shows the quiz on trylearnit.com. Ask for changes at any time and you get a new link.

To make the link, the quiz (its name, questions and answers) is sent to Learn It and stored there under a quiz code, the same way a quiz shared from the app is. Anyone who has the link or the code can open the quiz, so leave personal information out of it. Nothing else from your conversation is sent to Learn It.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make a quiz to practice in Learn It

payload.name: Accent Oracle by BoldVoice
payload.summaryOriginal: Find out what accent you have
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find out what your English accent sounds like with Accent Oracle by BoldVoice, the accent and pronunciation coaching app, right inside ChatGPT. Read a short paragraph aloud and BoldVoice predicts the accents your recording sounds most like, with probabilities and regions. If the first guess is uncertain, BoldVoice asks for one more paragraph to sharpen it. Ask ChatGPT to explain your result. Predictions describe how the recording sounds, not where you are from. No download, account or login needed. Your recording is sent to BoldVoice for analysis only when you stop recording.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中直接使用BoldVoice推出的Accent Oracle，即可了解你的英语口音特征。朗读一段短文后，BoldVoice会分析你的录音并预测最相似的口音类型及对应概率与地区。若首次预测结果不确定，BoldVoice会要求再提供一段文字以提高准确性。可让ChatGPT解释你的分析结果。预测结果仅描述语音特征，不涉及地理来源信息。无需下载、注册或登录账户，您的录音仅在停止录制时才会发送至BoldVoice进行分析。

payload.name: Whiteboard Video Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn any topic into a narrated whiteboard animation video without leaving ChatGPT. Describe what you want explained, and Whiteboard Video Maker writes the script, draws each scene with a hand-drawn whiteboard animation and adds a natural voiceover. Choose the length, landscape (YouTube) or portrait (Shorts, Reels, TikTok), the narration language and the voice. Videos render in a few minutes; ask whether your video is ready to get the MP4 download link and thumbnail. You can also list your recent videos and check your credit balance. Requires a Whiteboard Video account; videos use the account's credits (1 credit per minute) and ChatGPT asks you to confirm before creating one.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开ChatGPT即可将任何主题转化为带旁白的白板动画视频。描述需要解释的内容，Whiteboard Video Maker会撰写脚本，用手绘白板动画绘制每个场景并添加自然语音旁白。可选择视频时长、画布方向（YouTube横版或Shorts/Reels/TikTok竖版）、旁白语言和配音声音。视频几分钟内即可生成；可询问视频是否准备好以获取MP4下载链接和缩略图。您还可以查看最近制作的视频并检查积分余额。需要Whiteboard Video账户；视频会消耗账户积分（每分钟1积分），ChatGPT会在创建前向您确认。

payload.name: Talkio Practice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Prepare for travel, a job interview, a work meeting, or everyday conversation with short Talkio role-plays. Your assistant conducts the exercise, offers hints, and gives feedback on your replies. No Talkio account is required. Voice depends on the host. This plugin does not provide acoustic pronunciation scores or save progress to Talkio. An optional informational link explains Talkio and this practice activity. No purchases or subscription upgrades are offered.
payload.longDescription: 通过简短的Talkio角色扮演，为旅行、工作面试、工作会议或日常对话做好准备。您的助手将引导练习，提供提示并针对您的回复给予反馈。无需Talkio账户。语音由主机决定。此插件不提供发音评分或保存练习进度至Talkio。可选的信息链接解释了Talkio及此练习活动。不提供购买或订阅升级选项。

payload.name: MasterPiano
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MasterPiano helps piano learners find music they can actually play. Ask for classical sheet music by title, composer, era, ABRSM grade or level, and the score appears right in the chat with a play button, its MasterPiano level (1 to 100) and its approximate ABRSM grade.

What you can ask:

通过抄袭检测查看文档的原创性，并获取完整报告。

payload.name: LexIA Asistente Legal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Responde consultas jurídicas del Ecuador —tributarias, societarias, contables (NIIF), laborales y municipales— contra el corpus normativo de LexIA y la jurisprudencia contencioso-tributaria, y cita siempre la norma, el artículo y la fecha hasta la que llega el texto. With Google connected on Fiveable, list Classroom turn-ins, export grading results to a Google Sheet, and preview sending approved numeric AP scores to Classroom. 查看每个班级需要的支持方向。

payload.name: MasterKi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MasterKi is a spaced-repetition flashcard app for Android and iOS. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask ChatGPT to turn anything you're learning into flashcards: vocabulary from a language lesson, key points from lecture notes, an article, or the conversation you just had.

ChatGPT writes the cards and saves them to your MasterKi inbox. Nothing is added to your decks until you open MasterKi, review the cards, edit or remove any you don't want, and choose a deck. MasterKi then schedules each card so you review it just before you'd forget it.

To connect, sign in with your MasterKi email and password, or type a pairing code from the MasterKi app (Settings → Connect MasterKi to AI apps). MasterKi only receives the cards ChatGPT sends, never your conversation, and ChatGPT can't read or change your existing decks. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time from the app.

MasterKi syncs with Anki: connect your MasterKi account to Anki in the app (Settings), then cards ChatGPT saves to your MasterKi inbox can go into your Anki decks.

payload.name: Celpify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Celpify helps you prepare for the CELPIP-General test, the English test accepted for Canadian permanent residence and citizenship.

Practise CELPIP tasks from Celpify Test 1 in an interactive card inside the chat:
- Listening, with the audio and answer timers
- Reading, with the texts and questions
- Writing, with the time limit and a word count
- Speaking, with the prompt, pictures where the task has them, and preparation and speaking timers

When you finish a Listening or Reading task, check your answers in the card. You see your score, which answers are right or wrong, and the correct option for each question. The card shows the answers only after you check.

- How the CELPIP test is structured: parts and tasks, number of questions and time allowed, based on celpip.ca and the official CELPIP study materials
- Which Celpify study guides cover a topic, such as Listening Part 5 or Writing Task 2

No sign-in is needed.

Celpify is an independent practice platform. CELPIP is a registered trademark of Prometric Canada, and Celpify is not affiliated with or endorsed by Prometric Canada.
